events.event_name: JUNG SAEM MOOL × Van Leeuwen Mobile Pop-Up
events.address: Multiple Manhattan stops: Lexington Avenue; 557 Broadway; 21–27 9th Avenue
events.what_it_is: A mobile beauty-and-ice-cream activation celebrating JUNG SAEM MOOL Beauty's U.S. Sephora launch, with scheduled stops across Manhattan.
events.what_is_free: A special JUNG SAEM MOOL × Van Leeuwen ice cream is offered to guests who follow @jsmbeauty_global. A separate social-post giveaway offers a chance at a full-size Metal Lip Serum, limited to 200 units per day.
events.caveats: Current event listing says the mobile pop-up is open to the public. Free ice cream requires following @jsmbeauty_global; the full-size lip-serum promotion requires tagging/sharing and is limited to 200 units per day. Exact Lexington Avenue stop address is not stated in the source, so it is not guessed here.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 19 route: 11 AM–1 PM Lexington Avenue; 1:30–3:30 PM 557 Broadway; 4–7 PM 21–27 9th Avenue. Sept. 20 route: same first two stops; final stop 4–6 PM at 21–27 9th Avenue.

events.address: 406A Comfort Road, Governors Island, New York, NY 10004
events.what_it_is: A five-hour eco-arts festival with performances, installations, environmental-justice workshops and interactive activities at the Climate Imaginarium on Governors Island.
events.what_is_free: Festival admission, performances, installations and listed workshops are free.
events.caveats: Official Climate Week NYC calendar calls this a public event. Tickets are free and reservations are recommended rather than stated as mandatory.
events.practical_notes: Interactive activities, workshops and visual art run 11 AM–4 PM; performances run 12:45–2:45 PM. Governors Island ferry travel is separate from event admission.

events.event_name: Slow Summer Reading Party presented by Spotify
events.brand: Reading Rhythms × Brooklyn Bridge Park × Spotify
events.address: Pier 6 Liberty Lawn, Brooklyn Bridge Park, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: The final Slow Summer outdoor reading party of the season, with an hour of reading to live music, conversations and a discussion with author Josh Silver.
events.what_is_free: The reading party is free and open to the public. A current event listing also advertises giveaways for the first 300 guests.
events.caveats: Brooklyn Bridge Park explicitly says the event is free and open to the public and that RSVPs help organizers plan. RSVP is therefore optional, not a gate to admission. Outdoor event is subject to weather or other changes.
events.practical_notes: Lawn opens at 12:30 PM; official park programming is 1–3 PM. Bring a book and blanket/soft seat; chairs are not allowed on the lawn.

events.event_name: Art Is Alive Festival — 10th Anniversary Block Party
events.what_it_is: The finale of Asase Yaa's 10th annual Art Is Alive Festival, with live African-diasporic music and dance performances, a street marketplace, food/drink vendors and community programming.
events.what_is_free: Block-party admission and performances are free; donations are appreciated but not required. Food, drinks and marketplace goods may be sold separately.
events.caveats: The Saturday block party is advertised as free and open to the community. Earlier weekday classes have limited capacity and registration requirements; this record is specifically for the Sept. 19 block party and does not imply walk-in access to those classes.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, noon–7 PM, at/around Asase Yaa School of the Arts on Macdonough Street between Patchen Avenue and Malcolm X Boulevard.

events.event_name: New York Transit Museum Bus Festival
events.brand: New York Transit Museum × MTA New York City Transit
events.address: Emily Warren Roebling Plaza, 1 Water Street, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: A waterfront festival where visitors can board stationary vintage buses, explore the evolution of NYC's bus fleet, take part in activities and meet transit workers.
events.what_is_free: Festival admission, vintage-bus exploration and advertised activities are free.
events.caveats: Official organizer says advance registration is encouraged but not required. Registration enters guests in a membership raffle; it is not established as an admission requirement. Event runs rain or shine; buses/equipment are subject to change.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–3:30 PM. Children 15 and under must be accompanied by an adult. Vintage buses have stairs and boarding lines may occur.
